title: Cars for mv with all direction sprites?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:
Somehow all i can find don't have the up and down direction sprites. And posts with ones that do are very old and have a non-working links, like this post:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/looking-for-moving-car-sprites.33057/
Perhaps anyone knows something fitting? Don't need high quality since it's just for one small scene, but they must fit on the road from "earth" standard tileset.
Also i wonder if there are any car interior sprites?

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
A little forum search for cars should've turned this thread by me up
4-directional Cars (and trucks) for your RM needs
While MV and MZ come with static sideview cars, those are not only very limited in size and variety, but also they only come in sideview versions, making it difficult to bring actual life into your towns.  I find myself recommending mostly the same resources over and over, but to make them...
